# Vendibook

> The marketplace for mobile food vendors — buy or rent food trucks, food trailers, shared/commercial kitchens, and vendor spaces across the United States.

Vendibook connects food entrepreneurs with verified hosts. Every listing supports secure payments, identity verification, document workflows, and 24/7 support. Rentals and sales are protected by our checkout, dispute resolution, and host payout system.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and browse food trucks, trailers, kitchens, and vendor spaces.
- [Browse](/browse): Filtered marketplace search across all categories.
- [Cities](/cities): Listings by city and launch market.
- [Become a Host](/become-a-host): List your truck, trailer, kitchen, or vendor space.
- [How It Works (Hosts)](/how-it-works-host): Host onboarding, payouts, and protections.
- [How It Works (Sellers)](/how-it-works-seller): Selling a food truck or trailer on Vendibook.
- [Pricing Calculator](/pricing-calculator): Estimate fees and payouts.
- [Kitchen Earnings Calculator](/kitchen-earnings-calculator): Project earnings as a kitchen host.
- [Vendi AI Suite](/vendi-ai-suite): AI tools for listing creation and matching.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides for mobile food vendors.
- [Help](/help): Support articles and contact options.
